requirements.acceptance: Every changed implementation group and historical feature has a source-to-backend-to-screen-to-test chain. Negative: Delete a PR-only action, discard a complete candidate branch without dispositions, or report an inferred effect as observed: reject.
requirements.text: Source-preserving implementation admission: Keep exact source paths, commit and content hashes, test evidence, feature obligations and ADOPT/ADAPT/REFERENCE dispositions. Retain all source candidates until their replacement or rejection is explicitly justified; never accept a reviewed module solely because its parent branch has passing CI.

requirements.acceptance: A pending fill with a rejected venue stop triggers the same admitted recovery as an immediate fill and updates risk and Attention. Negative: Inject rejected/unknown protection at delayed or partial fill; a local rule alone must not yield CONFIRMED or permit additional risk.
requirements.text: Protection parity for immediate and pending fills: Route FILLED and PARTIAL receipts from all origins through one protection reconciler. Track REQUESTED, CONFIRMED, UNKNOWN and MISSING separately. Never register an intended local stop as proof of a venue stop. Apply the currently admitted immediate flatten/halt response unless an independently qualified owner-admitted bounded re-read/reattach policy replaces it; record timeout and unknown close outcomes.

requirements.acceptance: At-touch and gapped quote fixtures preserve the limit in both directions; explicit capped-market fixtures preserve their separate slippage envelope. Negative: The current 1.10000 limit with 0.00010 spread and 0.00002 slippage must never fill a BUY at 1.10007 or a SELL at 1.09993.
requirements.text: Limit-price invariants and explicit order semantics: BUY LIMIT fills at or below its limit and SELL LIMIT at or above it, using the relevant executable quote and eligible event time. An at-touch order that is not executable within its limit rests or is refused. A capped-market order is a distinct intent/template with its own signed semantics; logging a LIMIT-to-MARKET substitution does not make it authorized. Unknown venue capabilities deny the operation.

requirements.acceptance: A four-hour STOP_ENTRY cannot remain eligible for 24 hours; PRE_BLACKOUT/POST_BLACKOUT moves eligible pending orders into cancellation workflow. Negative: Drop max_wait, substitute a later expiry, or fill an ineligible resting order without reconciliation/Attention: fail.
requirements.text: Pending-order expiry and event-policy propagation: Bind policy digest, order expiry, mandate validity, market-session constraints and cancel-on-event rules into the immutable execution command and pending supervisor. Effective expiry is the earliest applicable allowed deadline; absent or stale policy is not a 24-hour default. Clock and source revisions remain explicit.

requirements.acceptance: EXPIRED, CANCELLED and REJECTED unfilled orders disappear from working-order totals but remain in historical records; partial positions retain actual exposure. Negative: A stale ACCEPTED receipt after terminal readback must not resurrect Working; duplicate fill/cancel events must not double-count.
requirements.text: Terminal order read models and monotonic lifecycle reduction: Project orders from the complete canonical lifecycle, ordered and deduplicated by broker event/sequence and reconciliation revision. PLACED is the code state and Working the label. Separate unfilled terminal orders from residual exposure after partial fills. Conflicting events become reconciliation-required, not last-arrival optimism.

requirements.acceptance: FX, JPY, metals and alternative broker digit fixtures produce correct bounds from actual contract metadata and remain within the approved loss envelope. Negative: Unknown digits, stale contract revision, a rounded stop beyond risk or below broker distance, or treating an old absolute cap as a new fraction: refuse.
requirements.text: Executable quantisation before authority and metadata-based slippage: Use provider SymbolContract tick size, point size, digits, units, min/freeze stops and revision to build the executable preview first. Validate stop side and distance, risk in account currency and lot step on exact decimals. Risk and owner approval bind those executable values. Version relative-price versus absolute-price versus points units; recalculate and reapprove if changed. Preserve the no-widening invariant but do not hide a broker-invalid too-close stop.

requirements.acceptance: New-row work scales with appended records while honest replay matches full verification in SQLite and Postgres. Negative: Tamper, truncate, fork, roll back, replace a ledger or supply a stale checkpoint: fail closed and force full verification. The research always-True monkeypatch is forbidden.
requirements.text: Incremental ledger verification with explicit integrity envelope: Retain verified incremental anchors and periodic full checks; bind ledger identity, row sequence/count, chain root, source epoch and checkpoint lifetime. Full verification is required on first use, detected change, failed incremental proof and the admitted maximum interval. Document the distinction between immediate detection of new-row/rechain/deletion faults and delayed detection of in-place historical edits; stronger write protection or integrity monitoring may reduce that window.

requirements.acceptance: Restart replays the same locks; independent manual/autonomous cooldown tests coexist with shared all-origin hard-limit tests. Negative: A restart resets losses, a default silently changes a signed policy, a manual entry bypasses total-account drawdown, or an owner reset erases economic loss: reject.
requirements.text: Signed lockout policy activation and persistent all-origin risk: Retain 24-hour cooldown, 0.5 probation and suspension after more than two cooldowns in seven days as the accepted values, not live authority. Bind all fields, scope rules and policy revision into the signed mandate before activating a changed production policy. Keep autonomous strategy/account and owner.manual cooldown scopes as recorded by OD-38; always apply economic all-origin account drawdown, margin, exposure and protection ceilings. Persist reset events, loss history, economic peaks and day/week baselines.

requirements.acceptance: Known-profit/loss fixtures match analytically specified results and the actual execution adapters' admitted semantics. Negative: Disabling controls, altering quote units or a permissive fill model without a distinct experiment identity invalidates promotion evidence.
requirements.text: Qualified chronological evaluator before automated strategy development: Establish one qualified evaluator version before candidate selection uses it. Separate isolation experiments from deployment-faithful evaluation; both declare code, data, controls, costs and random seeds. An independent fixture oracle checks event eligibility, bid/ask, limit/stop/expiry, partial fills, costs, cash flows and restart/risk controls.

requirements.acceptance: Replay of each named chronological fold yields the same pre-cutoff decisions and verified split provenance. Negative: Future-only perturbation changes past decisions, a scaler sees the holdout, or window count is only the count of calendar years: fail.
requirements.text: Leakage-proof chronology and genuine walk-forward records: Persist train/validation/test intervals, strategy frozen-at time, embargo/purge rules, label horizons, warmup-only data and candidate selection cutoffs. Mutating only unavailable future data must leave prior features and decisions unchanged. A deliberately leaking implementation must fail. Yearly summaries remain descriptive, not walk-forward windows; a 2025 label does not by itself create untouched out-of-sample evidence.

requirements.acceptance: From permitted raw inputs, a second run reproduces the same bars, sessions, costs and outcomes. Negative: Bid is silently treated as midpoint, fixed EST becomes DST-local time, a bar is used before close or a mirror is unpinned: reject qualifying use.
requirements.text: Immutable dataset, quote, calendar and cost provenance: Use a DatasetManifest with exact hashes, provider/mirror revision, permitted-use state, timezone/DST handling, bid/ask/mid semantics, bar timestamp conventions, missing/duplicate intervals and transformation code. Preserve full spread, commissions, financing, slippage, liquidity and FX assumptions per venue and period. A source access/usage gap is never hidden by calling fixtures live.

requirements.acceptance: Each reported metric identifies the population, formula/version, trial set, uncertainty and selection scope. Negative: A pooled PBO is relabeled pair-specific, losers disappear from trial count, or repeated holdout tuning is called independent: fail promotion.
requirements.text: Complete trial ledger and honest statistical interpretation: Record every tried configuration, failure, search budget, selection rule, effective trial treatment, untouched holdout and actual cost model. Label DSR and PBO according to their statistical meaning and calculation cohort, not chance of skill or trade-win probability. Economic admission is per exact dataset/evaluator/model/policy scope, separate from software completion.

requirements.acceptance: A weekly run is idempotent by period/strategy/dataset/evaluator; results reproduce and a candidate reaches only permitted next states. Negative: A model edits protected execution/risk paths, repeated runs duplicate studies, a failed candidate becomes a promotion opportunity, or an unsigned candidate trades live: refuse.
requirements.text: Governed weekly strategy-development lifecycle: One standing, scoped research grant may schedule offline diagnostics, generate candidate versions and evaluate them; it cannot alter live policy. Loss clusters generate hypotheses evaluated against winners, exposure/opportunity frequency and market regimes. Separate distribution drift from predictive deterioration. Preserve parents and all trials. Passing candidates appear as promotion proposals; failures and system faults stay inspectable. Live promotion uses a fresh exact artifact/policy-bound owner decision and stage evidence; automatic demotion only within an admitted reduce-risk policy.

requirements.acceptance: A pre-signed ticket arms only in its declared readiness envelope and can claim the nonce once. Negative: Empty proof, arbitrary real proof label, proof for another account/event, re-signed weakened allowlist or concurrent duplicate use: reject.
requirements.text: Typed proof sufficiency and news arming readiness: Keep duplicate rejection, exact transition allowlists and approval/submission/readback dominators. Extend proposed news SIGNED→ARMED with valid owner grant, pre-arm window, account/mandate/policy revisions, healthy required sources and unused nonce. Execution still needs the event's two-source agreement, current quote/risk and atomic nonce claim. Validate proof issuer, subject, digest, freshness and revocation at runtime; definitions do not execute checks.

requirements.acceptance: Deposit/withdrawal/credit/fee and pending-order interleavings reconcile exact money, positions and risk without false P&L. Negative: Redirect settles money, a timeout resubmits, deleting restores secrets, unclassified flow silently improves risk capital, or a withdrawal bypasses concurrent reservations: reject.
requirements.text: Funding and account deletion concurrency with economic accounting: Separate local unlink, archive, credential rotation and remote closure. Use durable idempotent funding intents, beneficiary/quote-bound approval, reserved outgoing collateral, debit/credit leg reconciliation and compensating reversals. Cash-flow-adjusted returns use a versioned unitization or equivalent tested convention; preserve economic drawdown separately from authorized risk resets. Fresh atomic checks prevent unlink/deletion or withdrawal racing a fill/unknown transfer.

requirements.acceptance: Every mapped owner action and new capability has one traceable caller and appropriate screen/sheet/dialog outcome. Negative: A visually complete screen lacks its source or any backend is unfinished; BG-001 and frontend entry refuse.
requirements.text: Complete backend consumer catalogue before native UX: Publish a revisioned capability/action/event/error/provenance catalogue for every admitted backend feature. Each operation declares read/write authority, availability, precision, stale semantics, approval, cancellation and receipt deep links. The full catalogue, not a fixed five-flow demo, drives information architecture and all-surface contracts after BG-001.

requirements.acceptance: Every one of the 90 forecast requirements maps to an active unit and test; all required child backend receipts reach BG-001. Negative: A child F15/BG independently opens UI, Qlib or Freqtrade sends a live order, or a unavailable provider is labeled healthy: reject.
requirements.text: Single forecasting integration without a second trading engine: Fold all 48 forecast-source packet obligations into the one parent graph, preserving their IDs through explicit aliases. Implement Qlib/LightGBM, NeuralForecast and admitted Freqtrade/FreqAI-derived lifecycle capabilities, prediction-market information and replay research labs. Retain VATI as the sole risk and order authority. No-procurement scope is preserved; live event-contract orders are not introduced.

requirements.acceptance: The complete pack rebuilds identically and invalid evidence cannot change readiness. Negative: Edit input and matching local hash, delete a receipt, swap source revision, self-declare signature_valid, or reuse device evidence across builds: block readiness.
requirements.text: Source-bound evidence promotion and non-self-issued certificates: Receipt eligibility binds exact source, configuration, test command, data, device/provider scope, issuer authority, freshness and failure evidence. Structural checks only validate the specification. F15, BG-001 and release gates require independently verified signed receipts through the qualified authority; no offline document tool can issue them. Guard proof, requirement locks and manifests remain PREPARED until owner approval.

requirements.acceptance: Full-scope native dark/light goldens, action reachability and physical S24 cases match the same backend catalogue revision. Negative: Only showcase flows pass, legacy UI leaks into new modules, safety states are hidden for aesthetics, or unknown data looks live: reject final qualification.
requirements.text: Full tactile design and feature preservation across every context: After BG-001, customize the accepted tactile spatial material/lighting/typography to each screen purpose. Preserve every context and 349 historical action entries, add strategy/forecast/execution-state views where needed, and retain accessible alternatives. A graph, chart workstation, funding confirmation and small orb hub share design DNA, not one repeated generic card layout.
Preserve inherited scope and branch improvements: Retain every mapped parent action and source-backed capability; no competing trading stack.
Admit complete targets and market scope: Resolve target units, cohorts, providers, required plugins, consumers and budget before implementation.
Respect independent F15 and backend-first authority: No code-bearing child may start before current parent F15 and source admission; frontend also requires global BG.
Lock tested libraries and isolate computation: Produce reproducible environment manifests and actual VM compatibility evidence without loading training stacks in T0.
Point-in-time source availability: Every feature source has event and availability timestamps, revision identity and provenance quality.
Survivorship and instrument identity: Universe and contract membership are as-of; canonical identity includes venue and contract, not ticker alone.
Calendar and bar completeness: Use closed observed bars and per-market session/business-time horizons with gap policy.
Single feature definition and offline-online parity: Reuse the VAN feature owner, version transformations and materialize Feast views without alternate T0 authority.
Train-only transforms and aligned row masks: Fit scalers, PCA, feature selection and outlier transforms only inside training boundaries; preserve X/y/weight alignment.
Controlled feature expansion: Lag, timeframe, peer and calendar features use an admitted DAG and measured feature budget.
Target maturity and event semantics: Every label records interval, available_at, cost treatment, censoring and target version.
Separate facts, practice and counterfactuals: Do not mix actual fills, paper/practice, inferred outcomes and synthetic fixtures in promotion statistics.
Return, ranking, volatility and cost targets: Provide all requested target families with correct domain and units; no binary-option payoff guessed as linear return.
Purged chronological validation: Purge overlapping label intervals across training/validation/calibration/test; synchronize cohort cutoffs.
Bias and warmup diagnostics: Build native lookahead/prefix and indicator-recursion checks; poison tests must demonstrate sensitivity.
Immutable final holdout and trial census: Pre-register holdout access and count architectures/features/horizons/calibrators tried, including failures.
Direction-neutral intrabar uncertainty: Use observed subbars/ticks or declared feasible market scenarios; never claim a long-only path is conservative for all sides.
Economic cost and valuation accounting: Debit monetary costs once and use realizable prices, latency, partial fills and post-liquidation equity.
Flow-adjusted and open-position risk metrics: Preserve cash-flow-neutral performance and current collateral/MTM drawdown as separate measurements.
Account-wide research-live parity: Use the real account coordinator and policy interfaces with isolated execution and reservation state.
Nonvacuous deterministic evidence: Determinism concerns specified events/decisions, not just final trade count or zero-checked replay.
Qlib model boundary and processor configuration: Use custom VAN data handlers; configure processor fitting, DK_L/DK_I and Recorder explicitly; no Qlib execution runtime.
LightGBM regression production adapter: Implement per-target/horizon expected-return/net-edge models and native export with exact transform manifest.
Calibratable setup classification: Implement binary target models with defined population and raw-probability semantics before separate calibration.
Quantile adapter completeness: Implement separate quantile/horizon objectives outside unsupported stock Qlib loss API.
Grouped ranking correctness: Train ranking with cutoff/universe query groups and appropriate nonnegative relevance coding; report ordinal scores.
Meaningful baseline and challenger comparisons: Implement XGBoost and simple/statistical incumbents against identical targets and calendars.
NeuralForecast shared data contract: Map unique_id/ds/y and exogenous inputs with immutable cutoffs and fold-scoped scalers.
N-HiTS complete research integration: Implement real NHITS training, multi-horizon inference, model persistence and shared provenance.
N-BEATSx contextual and interpretability integration: Implement supported exogenous inputs and optional native decomposition with noncausal explanations.
DeepAR distribution and path integration: Implement domain-valid distributions and retained individual temporal samples with seeds.
Complete challenger plugin interfaces: Implement TFT, PatchTST and iTransformer research plugins, gated by verified per-model capability matrix.
Reuse existing conformal ownership: Extend existing vati.risk.conformal and source-bound calibration producer; no independent sizing permission.
Honest probability and interval calibration: Validate disjoint calibration, empirical coverage and adequacy; label marginal/conditional limitations.
Calibration lineage and tail semantics: Bind calibration to exact model/transform/target; avoid unsupported joint-tail, stop-touch and transformed-mean claims.
One bounded optimization control: Use one Optuna/trial budget across Qlib/NF; all optimization only creates candidates.
Safe artifact and supply-chain boundary: Use native LightGBM and vetted safe neural formats; allowlisted loaders verify immutable bytes.
Registry is not authority: MLflow aliases and experiment status never grant forecast influence or strategy promotion.
Durable adaptive retraining: Implement per-scope jobs, cadence/drift triggers, leases, retries, checkpoints and safe cancellation.
Prevent schedule and resource starvation: Coalesce obsolete retrains with explicit receipts, bound queue/threads and protect serving/T0 capacity.
Typed forecast service and complete provenance: Emit ForecastPacket or abstention with scope, cutoffs, target, model, transformation and source evidence.
Independent freshness and OOD checks: Validate model age, data age, calibration age and novelty as separate dimensions.
Nonblocking inference and immutable cache: Preload admitted artifacts and cache by all material identities; T0 never awaits training/registry/network.
OOF-only forecast fusion and redundancy control: Learn combination only from out-of-fold predictions and track shared information across models.
Preserve trading and financial authority: Models propose evidence only; only existing RiskAuthority sizes and ExecutionRouter sends orders.
Independent edge evidence and mode integration: Supply real economic-evidence producer and signed scope binding for Normal/Risky/Aggressive policy use.
Complementary suppression without duplicate risk governor: Implement per-instrument/strategy cooldown and loss/profit protections through existing risk controls.
Outcome attribution and scientific data moat: Join all eligible candidates and model outputs to observed decisions/outcomes and label unobserved counterfactuals.
Privacy and correction propagation: Respect entitlements/consent; invalidate downstream datasets/models when affected source is corrected/revoked.
Every capability has a genuine caller and readback: Publish complete catalog/actions/error states and actual gateway operations without new frontend implementation.
Truthful confidence and explanation surfaces: Keep raw rank/rule score, calibrated event probability, intervals and economic evidence distinct.
Authorized VM deployment and recovery: Use qualified Global DIAL/Zuul execution routes, exact source, resource admission and tested isolation.
Bounded capacity and observability: Measure real CPU/memory/latency/disk and keep risk/protection independent of research load.
Actual statistical and economic evaluation: Use matched OOS forecasts, costs, intervals, DSR/PBO where applicable and pre-registered uncertainty analysis.
Real shadow pipeline and full rejection path: Exercise the real pipeline in shadow/sandbox and preserve prospective timestamped outcomes.
Independent complete additive backend closure: All mandatory backend engineering must have real source/service/caller/failure evidence.
Global backend barrier and contract renewal: Integrate with all parent backend/BQ obligations; renew BG before any new UX/frontend.
Complete post-backend UI integration: Apply every forecast capability/state/action in appropriate existing native screen families after BG.
Physical and whole-product final acceptance: Actual S24 and signed app use the qualified backend and preserve all inherited actions.
Separate software release from live-model promotion: Release software by parent policy; live influence requires independent model/strategy/account admission and owner authority.

Separate deployment, source access and procurement: Record Netcup/Oracle execution profiles; no licence procurement or external spending in this phase; no inference that VM location establishes operator eligibility.

Non-blocking no-procurement development path: Provide implemented fixture/replay and provider-adapter paths; source-use status is scoped; absent purchased licence cannot block ordinary specification, coding or fixture validation.

Versioned bounded read-only adapters: Implement allowlisted market-data REST and optional read-only streaming with pinned contract revisions, timeouts, rate budgets and cursor handling; no order/account mutations.

Point-in-time archive and live completeness: Store publication/receive/availability clocks and per-record historical cutoffs; dedupe and reconcile archive handoffs without inventing past receipt times.
Exact bid and ask conversion: Parse fixed-point price/quantity strings and derive YES asks from NO bids and vice versa; retain source book and executable depth.
Stream gap and sequence recovery: Apply sequence-aware deltas idempotently; gaps, negative resulting depth or duplicate mismatches force INVALID until full resynchronization.

Canonical event and proposition identity: Bind thresholds/comparators, units, timezones, official source/vintage and rules digest; distinguish exact, complement, overlapping and non-equivalent contracts.
Resolution and cash settlement are separate: Track occurrence, release, close, provisional outcome, dispute/cancel and final settlement separately; corrections create versions.
Maturity-aware contract continuity: Key probability changes by event/proposition/horizon and explicit roll rule; missing successor contracts produce missing features.
Coherent distributions without fabricated tails: Differentiate mutually exclusive bins from overlapping thresholds; monotonicity, mass, open-tail and adjustment policies are explicit.
Quality-aware market-implied estimates: Track estimator type, depth, spread, age, activity and rule coherence separately from calibration; empty books produce missing observations.
Freeze expectations before official information: Link each surprise to the last genuinely available pre-release snapshot and official release vintage; no future availability.

Two-source agreement is not independence: Preserve parent Kalshi/Polymarket liquidity/agreement rules for armed expectations; matching horizons and semantic relation required; no independent-evidence multiplication.

Event-grouped calibration and adequate evidence: Calibrate by declared event family/horizon/cohort with matured labels; group dependent snapshots/contracts and report effective event counts and uncertainty.
Preserve probability meaning: Market-implied estimate, calibrated physical-event probability, asset outcome probability and rank score are distinct types and fields.

Correct Qlib and neural event-feature adapters: Feed as-of event features to existing Qlib/LightGBM tasks and supported NeuralForecast historical covariates; future calendar use is versioned and not future probabilities.

Conditional asset response and incremental information: Estimate event-to-instrument outcomes under context, timing and horizon; compare against conventional market/news/calendar features and use OOF fusion.
Preserve D1–D7 and manual ownership: External information affects entries/ranking/lifecycle only through inherited rules; D7 is required for news-generated added risk; existing risk authority sizes.

Net executable binary-contract value: For held-to-settlement use expected payout minus actual entry costs/fees/lockup; for early exit use executable exit distribution; market price is not independent edge.

Full event-loss and portfolio stress: Model maximum binary outlay, related event exposures and uncertain probabilities; Kelly-style analysis remains a bounded sandbox proposal, never sizing authority.
Exact fees and complete settlement accounting: Use revision/series/account-specific fee rules, per-fill precision/accumulator, cash reservations and all relevant settlement/conversion costs.
Queue-aware feasible event execution: Model real observation/decision/order latency, depth, partial fills, queue uncertainty and cancel races; sparse data cannot prove maker profitability.
Payoff-proven contract consistency: Enumerate permissible resolution/void/dispute states and quantities; exact/complement matching precedes worst-case net-payoff assessment.
Non-atomic multi-venue risk and capital: Keep venue-specific balances, collateral/currency conversion and hedge-failure unwind costs; no instant cross-venue capital or fill assumption.
Inventory-aware event quoting laboratory: Implement bounded quoting policies with event-family inventory, jump risk, adverse selection and value conditional on fills; no direct live execution.
Maker quote lifecycle and protective withdrawal: Simulate pending/new/partial/cancel/unknown quote states, stale-feed reduction and scheduled-event withdrawal without manipulating markets.

Four preregistered incremental-value studies: Implement risk-filter, surprise, volatility and ranking studies with identical opportunity sets, incumbent/calendar/exposure-matched controls and frozen utility.
Prospective sealing and dependent uncertainty: Seal issued forecasts before outcomes, use event/time-block inference and full trial census; compare realistic lags and negative controls.

Complete owner projections and operator controls: Extend existing event/research/work/evidence/settings and later native surfaces with source state, expectation lineage, study/lab controls, calibration and per-use outcomes.

Failure isolation and truthful full-backend closure: Isolate event workers from T0 and finance; complete recovery, revocation and rollback; all new backend obligations feed existing gates without purchasing licences or fabricating access.
